_about: One license as stored in our knowledge base (data/processed/licenses.json, 47 licenses, 34
in scope). Title, description, labels and text come from choosealicense.com; in_scope and
language are ours. The labels (permissions, conditions, limitations) are what the
profiles' correct answers are computed from, and what the Phase 2 prompt shows the LLM.
